inspectionScope: Audit only — no classifier fixes, no canonical mutation, no P08 resolution, no pilot closure
executiveSummary: Governance/safety layer is GREEN. P05 exposes a confirmed production-pipeline matcher gap: range_oven ontology and CG-12-approved samsung_range_ne58 manufacturer overlay are not wired into canonical_matcher or overlay_candidate_builder, causing induction implementation terms to land as unresolved_block instead of implementation_specific overlay routing. P08 architecture_exception STOP is correct; evidence supports composition insufficiency without a frozen dual-load orchestration contract — human architectural triage required before any fit/overlay work. Disposition classifier conflates overlay/compound presence with terminal implementation_specific disposition, masking canonical_mapping_continue on slots that did map (P01–P03, P07).

p05Audit.rootCause: Production normalization pipeline has no range_oven canonical path. canonical_matcher._canonical_ontology_path() returns null for induction_range; load_canonical_component_ids() yields empty set; extend_alias_registry_for_platform() exits early when template_id != washer — so CG-12-approved manufacturer overlay samsung_range_ne58.json (igbt→surface_heating_system, assy_inverter_module→surface_heating_system, etc.) is never loaded. overlay_candidate_builder._ontology_path_for_template() also omits range templates, so cooktop procedures lack range test-target validation and implementation overlay bindings.
p05Audit.whyUnresolvedBlockNotImplementationSpeci: pilot_batch._classify_manual_slot() sets unresolved_block when UNRESOLVED_TERM > 0 AND candidate-status mapped count == 0. P05 has 21 UNRESOLVED, 0 candidate mappings, 1 overlay (door_lock only via washer tag heuristic). Branch for implementation_specific requires overlayCandidates > 0 OR COMPOUND_TERM_CANDIDATE > 0 without passing unresolved_block first — but unresolved_block takes precedence when mapped_count == 0.

p08Audit.compositionQuestion: Can FlexWash be represented as composition of frozen functional contracts without distorting diagnostic ontology?
p08Audit.rationale: Lower-compartment and shared-infrastructure procedures compose cleanly onto front_load_washer (drain, inlet, heater, thermistor, lower motor, lower door lock, power, HMI). Dual-load partition procedures cannot bind to single-drum front_load_washer without collapsing compartment scope — upper door maps to door_lock without upper/lower instance, upper motor conflicts with single drive_motor, interload AC7 has no canonical orchestration target. AIO laundry combo precedent (CG_AIO_LAUNDRY_COMBO_RETURN_TRIANGULATION_v1.json) used composition_reference + integrated_laundry_orchestration without forcing dual wash drums into one FL graph — FlexWash needs analogous dual_load_integrated_orchestration boundary, which is not frozen.
